name: Backrooms
detailed_description:
What happens when reality glitches and you fall through the cracks?
Welcome to the Backrooms, an endless maze of yellowed walls, humming fluorescent lights, and damp, musty carpets. A place outside of time and space. A place you're not supposed to be.

In this atmospheric first-person psychological horror experience, you awaken in the liminal space known only as the Backrooms. There are no checkpoints. No maps. Only echoes... and something watching.

🕯️ Explore the Infinite

Wander through procedurally generated levels, each more surreal—and more dangerous—than the last. From decaying office spaces to shifting industrial corridors, every zone offers new mysteries, environments, and horrors.

👂 Sound is Survival

Every creak, every flicker of a light, and every distant footstep matters. Stay quiet. Stay alert. And whatever you do… don’t attract attention.

🧠 Psychological Tension

With minimal UI, immersive visuals, and spatial audio design, you'll feel the isolation seep into your mind. The Backrooms is not just a place—it's a state of being. And it wants you to stay.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Quad CPU Q6600 @ 2.40GHz / AMD Phenom 9850 Quad-Core Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX11 Compatible GeForce GTX 460 1GB or AMD HD 6850 2GB
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
